name: Sunflower Labs (The Bee + Hive)
description: An autonomous residential drone-in-a-box security system: ground sensors ("Sunflowers") detect motion/vibration and trigger a fully autonomous drone ("Bee") to launch from its dock ("Hive"), fly to investigate, and stream live video — no pilot needed.

specs.label: Camera
specs.note: 50°(v)/100°(h) FOV; optional thermal on newer hardware

specs.label: Bee Dimensions
specs.note: body only; 48 × 48 × 21 cm with propeller guards

specs.label: Subscription
specs.note: only a usage-based ~$4–7/hr flight-operating cost is documented; no separate cloud-storage subscription found

sourcing: Verified against Sunflower Labs' own official site (sunflower-labs.com) and funding/regulatory press releases (BusinessWire, 2020 and 2025), plus independent hands-on coverage from TechCrunch and Engadget. This is an actively shipping, expanding product — Sunflower Labs reported more than doubling its customer base and 10x-ing autonomous patrol volume in the year before its November 2025 raise, with deployments across North America, Europe, Japan, Australia, and Argentina — not a demo-only pilot phase, despite the "New & Pending" tag reflecting that it hasn't yet been given its own detailed comparison against mainstream consumer security products in this catalog.

pricing.summary: Originally launched in 2020 at **$9,950** hardware plus a $999 deposit. Pricing is now quote-based through an online property-configuration tool rather than a fixed number, with reported ongoing operating costs of roughly $4–7 per hour of active drone flight, plus an 8–12 week installation process — reflecting its positioning as a premium, estate-scale system rather than an off-the-shelf consumer product.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: As of November 2025, Sunflower Labs holds a nationwide, performance-based FAA waiver covering roughly 99% of the US that permits beyond-visual-line-of-sight flight, operation over people and vehicles, and low-visibility flight without needing per-site approval — a significant upgrade from the case-by-case Part 107 waivers the system previously required.

firmwareCommunity.note: Sunflower Labs has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API for The Bee + Hive. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
